summary: Defined compatibility and migration validation contracts that block unsupported runtime versions, unsafe optional dependency fallback and downgrade without rollback.
acceptance_evidence: CompatibilityRequirement validates runtime contract version range, supported architectures, host feature requirements and migration rules.
CompatibilityValidationReportV1 blocks activation when runtime version or architecture is unsupported or required host features are missing.
Optional host features can degrade but do not authorize host mutation.
MigrationRule rejects downgrade paths without explicit rollback contract.

commands.summary: Functional capability replay passed and wrote .workflow/artifacts/functional-replay/result.json.

blocked_shortcuts: Missing optional dependencies cannot mutate the host.
Downgrade cannot proceed without rollback contract.
optional_dependencies: KVM/Firecracker-like optional host features can be represented as missing optional features without enabling host fallback.
promotion_impact: Adds compatibility gates required before execution-image, runtime-adapter and future model/knowledge packs can activate safely.
